personality.speech_style: precise and educated, uses alchemical terminology, speaks with underlying worry

general: Runs the village apothecary for 30 years
Trained Archibald as an apprentice before his descent into madness
Expert in herbal remedies and basic alchemy
Feels responsible for not seeing the warning signs in Archibald
local_lore: The Thornwood Laboratory was abandoned after a fire 50 years ago
Archibald was brilliant but obsessed with pushing boundaries
Strange lights and explosions have been seen at the laboratory for weeks

shop.sell_dialogue: I have remedies and alchemical supplies. What do you need?
shop.insufficient_funds_dialogue: I'm afraid I can't extend credit, even in these troubled times.

dialogue.greeting: Ah, travelers! Thank goodness you've come. I desperately need help with a... delicate matter.
dialogue.farewell: Be careful out there. And please, stop Archibald before it's too late.
dialogue.hostile_greeting: I don't have time for troublemakers. Please leave.

personality.speech_style: calm and reassuring, asks probing questions, explains things clearly

general: Trained in both mundane medicine and detecting magical ailments
Has treated several villagers for mysterious symptoms lately
Suspects something unnatural is at work in the area
local_lore: Several villagers have reported feeling unwell near the old laboratory
Animals have been avoiding the area around Thornwood Hill
The symptoms she's seen don't match any natural illness

shop.sell_dialogue: I have healing supplies if you need them. Staying healthy is important work.
shop.insufficient_funds_dialogue: I wish I could give these away, but I need coin for more supplies.

dialogue.greeting: Welcome, traveler. Are you injured? Or perhaps you've come about the strange sickness in the village?
dialogue.farewell: Take care of yourself. And if you feel any strange symptoms, come see me immediately.
dialogue.hostile_greeting: I heal all who come to me, but I won't tolerate threats in my home.

personality.speech_style: formal but approachable, concerned with public safety, offers rewards

general: Elected mayor of the village 8 years ago
Responsible for the safety and well-being of all villagers
Has been fielding complaints about the laboratory for weeks
Doesn't have the budget for a proper militia
local_lore: The village has prospered under his leadership
The old Thornwood family (his ancestors) built the laboratory
He's ashamed that his family's legacy has become a threat

dialogue.greeting: Ah, adventurers! The village could use capable folk like yourselves. We have a problem that needs solving.
dialogue.farewell: The village thanks you for your service. May fortune favor your endeavors.
dialogue.hostile_greeting: I am the duly elected mayor of this village. You will show respect or face the consequences.
